rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being out of danger, free from risk, protected, or securely kept.
Use this for a person, choice, or thing that is reliable and can be trusted rather than merely free from physical danger.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 hou2 wan2 zan6

rows.note: Use this slangy word when safe means cool, great, or worthy of approval.

example.english: That new phone is safe—it’s really cool and worth buying.
example.traditional: 呢部新手機真係正，買得過！
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1 zan1 hai6 zing3 maai5 dak1 gwo3
